```python
bitwise_and(x, y) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Elementwise bitwise AND (`x & y`). Both operands must have integer
or bool dtype (`core.DTypeError` otherwise). Dtype/shape rules
identical to `add`.
